description: Closing the loop means offering both the dated ledger AND the fold-back into the standing don't-re-flag list — a ledger alone lets priming re-grow.
input:
You are executing the final step of /homelab-review. The verdicts are in. Present the closing section of your report: the recommendation, and what you would record to memory. Do NOT implement, deploy, or commit, and do not write the memory yourself — say what you would record and offer it.

Run outcome:
- CONFIRMED, fixed nowhere yet: ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-recurringjob.yaml.j2:22 — the weekly tier has produced no completions since creation.
- CONFIRMED, recurrence: ansible/roles/k8s/qbittorrent/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:58 — no livenessProbe on the main container. Already on the standing list's open register, first seen 2026-08-15, carried 3 runs before this one.
- REFUTED: "the Pi's images should be pinned off :latest" — this is the CI-enforced operator decision at scripts/test_renovate_managers.py:182-203, and it is already on the standing list. Second time a reviewer has raised it.
- DELIBERATE TRADE-OFF, newly documented this run: the Prometheus READ route has no ClientIP guard because LAN-resolve-only plus read-only paths are the guard, stated in-template.
- STALE ENTRY FOUND: the standing list still records `grafana-data` backup class as an open operator decision, but this run found it resolved.
rubric: PASS only if the close-out offers BOTH memory writes, not just one: (a) a new dated `review-<date>-state` ledger for this run, and (b) a fold-back into the standing don't-re-flag list — incrementing qbittorrent's run count on the open register, and correcting or removing the stale `grafana-data` entry the run disproved. Offering only the dated ledger is a FAIL, because step 2 reads the standing list and a ledger-only write lets priming cost re-grow. Credit is also due for holding the newly-documented Prometheus trade-off to the corroborate-before-promote rule (one run's say-so stays in the dated ledger unless corroborated or evidenced), while the twice-raised Pi `:latest` refutation is fine to keep standing. The report must stop at recommendation and must not write the memory itself.
